description: SolarNode is the field-device component of the SolarNetwork platform. Its README says low-power networked nodes collect readings from attached devices, post them to SolarNetwork and carry out instructions returned by that service. Operators configure compatible solar or energy equipment and a network connection; outputs are timestamped device observations and command responses. Geographic coverage follows installed nodes, not a public fixed dataset. GitHub metadata states GPL-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that this repository alone does not provide a complete SolarNetwork service or guarantee compatible sensors; missing communications, clock errors and device calibration can affect analysis. SolarNode can feed measured distributed-generation or storage states into digital-twin simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model optimises scenarios but does not collect site telemetry. No firmware image, device credential or sensor series was downloaded.
name: SolarNode distributed energy telemetry gateway
